description: Annual Passenger Border Crossings with Michigan & New York is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by Bridge and Tunnel Operators Association. This data is reported by each respective bridge crossing management authority for a combined total of both directions of travel for border crossings to Canada from Michigan and New York. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 23 columns, among them 2012, 2014, US States and Territories, US Counties Shapefile, Longitude, 2017. The portal shows 2025-03-14 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bridge and Tunnel Operators Association. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
